declarations.docstring: The representation invariant agrees for representations whose associated modules are linearly equivalent.
A surjective equivariant linear map transfers the specified supremum-equals-top property to its target.
The specified supremum for the representation indexed by a natural-valued tuple is top.
A representation satisfying the stated auxiliary conditions is isomorphic to the indexed representation when their invariants and dimensions agree.
An auxiliary definition whose formal type is unavailable.
An equivariant direct-sum decomposition yields the displayed equality between weighted sums of representation invariants.
Every positive-multiplicity summand in the equivariant direct-sum decomposition has the specified supremum equal to top.
Every positive-multiplicity summand in the equivariant direct-sum decomposition satisfies the specified auxiliary predicate.
Pairwise nonisomorphic simple summands of the decomposition admit an injective labeling whose labels determine their invariants.
The invariants of pairwise nonisomorphic simple summands are linearly independent under the stated supremum and auxiliary conditions.
An equivariant decomposition into simple summands admits an injective indexing of the prescribed invariant values by summands.
A simple module embedded in a finite direct sum of simple modules is linearly equivalent to one of the summands.
A simple representation satisfying the stated supremum and auxiliary conditions is isomorphic to the indexed representation with the same invariant.
